_comment: Sample MCP client configs for ratatoskr. Copy any entry into your MCP client settings.

star-wars-graphql._comment: Star Wars GraphQL API — characters, films, planets, species, starships

star-wars-graphql-filtered._comment: Star Wars GraphQL — only character queries (demonstrates endpoint allowlist)

dad-jokes-rest._comment: icanhazdadjoke.com REST — random jokes, search, lookup by ID. No auth needed. NOTE: spec URL requires the repo to be accessible; prefer dad-jokes-graphql for simplicity.

dad-jokes-graphql._comment: icanhazdadjoke.com GraphQL endpoint — alternative to REST

nasa-apod._comment: NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day — pass date param for historical images. Uses DEMO_KEY (free, rate-limited) — register at https://api.nasa.gov for a personal key.
